hypothesis: A structured variation of the five-row canonical index_matrix can preserve complete circle feasibility for the verified 5-violation coefficient vector and expose a potential with fewer full taxi violations than the fixed index matrix.
rationale: The pinned canonical-potential hint explicitly permits searching index_matrix, while coefficient-only local repair, preserved circle-zero selection, and a nonlinear spread correction all failed. The current matrix contains a repeated antipodal row and a specific signed pattern over seven abstract points; changing the row-0 anchor or applying a global cyclic relabel changes the potential representation without changing the evaluator or metric.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the canonical matrix itself is a restrictive bottleneck for the near-target seed. A variant with zero complete-circle violations justifies at most two exact taxi gates; no circle-feasible variant closes this structured matrix family before taxi-scale computation.
method: Load the locked upstream source and complete circle_k4_m6 metric. Hold the independently reproduced SEED_VECTORS[0] coefficients fixed. Evaluate the base matrix as a control, thirteen distinct row-0 uniform signed-anchor replacements, and six global cyclic relabels of all absolute indices. For every variant, compute the exact potential at all 1,001 nodes and count violations over all 6,006 circle edges. Canonicalize only by preserving the explicit variant list; do not use individual taxi failure edges. If any variant scores zero on the complete circle instance, exact-score at most two such variants on the full taxi metric with eight streaming workers and independently reproduce any result below 3.
metric: screening: exact complete circle_k4_m6 violations_k; primary follow-up only for circle-feasible variants: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Circle feasibility is a necessary finite screen only. The frozen target requires an exact full taxi result below 3, and any finite result remains incomplete evidence for the full k-server conjecture.

compute_budget.cpu: single circle-node evaluation process; optional eight bounded streaming workers for at most two circle-feasible taxi finalists
compute_budget.memory_intent: retain one node-potential vector per variant; no taxi cache

kill_condition: Stop after the complete variant list, at 600 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Run no taxi follow-up if every non-control variant violates the complete circle metric. Do not infer target progress from circle scores alone.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: only a circle-feasible matrix variant can enter the exact taxi gate; strict target progress requires violations_k < 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: matrix variation is a new representation family and must first preserve complete-circle feasibility

interpretation: Pending execution; no result is interpreted before the complete structured matrix screen runs.
what_was_learned: Pending execution; the test asks whether the fixed canonical index_matrix, rather than the coefficient vector, is the dominant restriction near the reported taxi result.
recommended_next_action: After execution, exact-score at most two circle-feasible matrix variants; if none are circle-feasible, close this structured matrix family and pause for a different global mechanism or runtime.
repetition_justification: This changes the index_matrix representation using a deterministic structured family permitted by the upstream hint. It is not a coefficient perturbation, nonlinear spread correction, fixed-edge proxy, circle-zero shortlist, or worker-count variation.
